svg.title: Maag control system: one path to every actuator
svg.text: The control system · one path to every actuator
Whoever asks, you or an agent, the safety governor decides. The ESPHome nodes can still refuse on their own.
Only the interface may write it (ACL)
Only at Agent proposes or autonomous
Never with the kill switch on
The only path to an actuator. Unknown means denied.
The topic decides. A module must be enabled
and allowed this actuator in its manifest.
On: every agent request is denied.
Off: only turning things off. Manual: you,
and turning off. Agents: proposes and up.
Min, max and per hour, from limits.yaml.
An action with no limit is always denied.
Door, E-stop, water, arm stowed, gantry still.

and the plant not marked dead.
Per action: never, agent or always.
A cut always waits for you.
